# `silk/bench/render`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Draws a benchmark report as text: a table for a terminal, with optional color, and Markdown.

## When to use
Call [`Render.terminal`](#Render.impl.terminal) or [`Render.markdown`](#Render.impl.markdown) on a `silk.bench.record.Report` to show a
saved run again, or to put a run in a pull request. `silk.bench.bench` calls them for the
outputs a suite declares with `Format.Terminal` and `Format.Markdown`. Use
`silk.bench.html` for a page with charts.

## Details
Each benchmark is one table with one row for each implementation: the median time, its 95%
interval, the fastest run, the processor time, the peak memory, and the ratio to the
reference with its interval and verdict. A table of result lines has the median in the unit
of the lines and, in place of the processor time and the memory, one column for each other
unit the lines carry. A renderer computes nothing: every number comes
from the report.

With color, a ratio is green or red only when its verdict is `faster` or `slower`, and dim
when no difference was found. The words stay, so a report without color, or read by someone
who cannot tell the colors apart, says the same.

Import as `Render` with `import silk.bench.render { Render }`.

<a id="Render.impl.terminal"></a>

### Associated function `terminal`

```silk
pub effect fn terminal(report: &Report, color: bool) -> String
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns `report` as a table for a terminal. With `color`, it holds ANSI escape codes.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` cannot supply the text.

<a id="Render.impl.markdown"></a>

### Associated function `markdown`

```silk
pub effect fn markdown(report: &Report) -> String
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns `report` as Markdown: a heading and a table for each benchmark, then the run's
details as a list.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` cannot supply the text.

<a id="Render.impl.restates"></a>

### Associated function `restates`

```silk
pub fn restates(report: &Report, chart: &Chart) -> bool
```

Returns the lines that describe the run of `report` under its tables: the computer, the
dates, the label, the revisions, and the notes.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` cannot supply the lines.
Returns whether `chart` says only what the tables of `report` already say: the median of
every implementation relative to the reference, for each benchmark. The terminal and
Markdown reports leave such a chart out.

<a id="Render.impl.grid"></a>

### Associated function `grid`

```silk
pub effect fn grid(chart: &Chart, panel: &Panel) -> List<List<String>>
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns `panel` of `chart` as the rows of a table, for a renderer that shows a chart as
text: a heading row, then one row for each series with one cell for each entry of the
axis. A `distribution` gets the columns `runs`, `smallest`, `largest` and `spread`, where
the spread is a small histogram of the measured runs between the smallest and the largest
value of the panel.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` cannot supply the cells.

<a id="Render.impl.titles"></a>

### Associated function `titles`

```silk
pub effect fn titles(report: &Report, table: &Table) -> List<String>
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns the column titles of `table`, for a renderer that draws its own table: the
implementation, the median, its interval, the best value, the processor time and peak
memory of a table of process times or one column for each other unit of a table of result
lines, and last the comparison to the reference.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` cannot supply the titles.

<a id="Render.impl.cells"></a>

### Associated function `cells`

```silk
pub effect fn cells(report: &Report, table: &Table, row: &Row) -> List<String>
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns the cells of `row`, a row of `table`, as text: one for each title of
[`Render.titles`](#Render.impl.titles). A row with no successful run has `-` in every cell between its name and
its comparison.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` cannot supply the cells.

<a id="Render.impl.memory"></a>

### Associated function `memory`

```silk
pub effect fn memory(row: &Row, floor: u64) -> String
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns the text of the peak memory column for `row`, such as `4.20 MiB`. A peak that is
not above `floor`, the smallest the run could see, is written as `≤ 16.6 MiB`.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` cannot supply the text.

<a id="Render.impl.comparison"></a>

### Associated function `comparison`

```silk
pub effect fn comparison(row: &Row) -> String
    ! OutOfMemoryError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns the text of the ratio column for `row`: `reference`, `-` for a row with no
successful run, or the ratio with its interval and verdict, such as
`0.49x [0.47, 0.51] faster`.

#### Errors
`OutOfMemoryError` if the `Allocator` cannot supply the text.
